document.title: Form PENS.S/2 — Signature Specimen of Appointed Legal Guardian

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/2 — Signature Specimen of Appointed Legal Guardian
chunks.heading: What form PENS.S/2 is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.S/2 is used by appointed legal guardians who have been approved by the Fund to register their signature with UNJSPF.

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/2 — Signature Specimen of Appointed Legal Guardian
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.S/2
chunks.text: Section 1 - Retiree or beneficiary information (UID, pension number, retirement number, name); Section 2 - Appointed legal guardian information (UID, date of birth, name, address, contact details); Section 3 - Acknowledgement and signature specimen; Section 4 - Signature authentication.

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/2 — Signature Specimen of Appointed Legal Guardian
chunks.heading: Signature authentication and legal guardian recognition on form PENS.S/2
chunks.text: The form is submitted for signature registration only; to be recognized by the Fund as a legal guardian, the person must be appointed by an appropriate judicial authority in the retiree's or beneficiary's country of residence, with a full copy of the judicial decision submitted to the Fund for approval. The guardian must sign the form in the presence of a United Nations official, government official or notary public, and UNJSPF retains the signature on file for verification; a new form is required if the signature changes.
